page.layout: One printed page. Running head centred at top. Below it, an ornamental rule, a centred title, and a centred letter "A.". Then two columns of index entries, left and right. The catchword sits at the lower right. The right edge of the neighbouring page is visible and is not transcribed.

main_text.head: INDEX AUTORUM, qui in hoc opere allegan-tur.

page.notes: The large "A" at the start of the first entry is a decorative initial and is joined to "Bumasar". The entry "Alpharabius" has a small mark after it in the scan. "Baptista" at the lower right is the catchword for the next page. No page number is printed. The right edge of the neighbouring page is not transcribed.
